name: GnollHack Roguelike Intelligence Benchmark Suite
description: Standard 15-question benchmark evaluating domain game knowledge, spoiler comprehension, monster/item stats, and C codebase logic.

questions.questionText: What are the base stats, alignment, and starting inventory of a Gnoll Barbarian in GnollHack?
questions.expectedPoints: Gnoll barbarian starting stats (high STR/CON), neutral or chaotic alignment, two-handed sword or battle-axe, leather armor, food rations.

questions.questionText: What happens when a player drinks a cursed potion of gain level in GnollHack?
questions.expectedPoints: Rises up through the dungeon ceiling to the level above, or fails in special non-connected branch levels and endgames.

questions.questionText: How does the ring of slow digestion interact with hunger and nutrition in GnollHack?
questions.expectedPoints: Stops standard 1-point intrinsic hunger per turn; does not stop hunger consumed by active spellcasting or special intrinsic burns.

questions.questionText: What are the resistances and special attacks of an Adult Red Dragon in GnollHack?
questions.expectedPoints: Fire resistance, fire breath weapon attack, claw/bite physical attacks, high AC and HP.

questions.questionText: What is the weight, base AC, and intrinsic property granted by Silver Dragon Scale Mail in GnollHack?
questions.expectedPoints: Base weight (40), base AC (9 / effective AC reduction), reflection intrinsic property.

questions.questionText: Explain how the Blessed Scroll of Identify functions differently from an Uncursed Scroll of Identify in GnollHack.
questions.expectedPoints: Blessed identifies all items in inventory or a random percentage (typically 1 to all / 20-100%); uncursed identifies exactly one selected item.

questions.questionText: How does prayer timeout work in GnollHack? What conditions make a god angry upon praying, and what determines prayer recovery time?
questions.expectedPoints: Prayer timeout counter (~800-1000 turns based on luck/piety), praying within timeout angers deity, luck penalty, hostile minion summoning or smiting.

questions.questionText: Describe the differences between NetHack 3.6.2 and GnollHack regarding the skill system, weapon proficiencies, and spellcasting failure rates.
questions.expectedPoints: GnollHack skill leveling through continuous usage/exercise, spell failure adjustments based on armor encumbrance and mental stats, expanded weapon tiers.

questions.questionText: What is the exact mechanic for taming monsters using food in GnollHack? Which monster types cannot be tamed this way?
questions.expectedPoints: Throwing appropriate food (meat for domestic canines/felines, veggies/fruits for equines/herbivores), peaceful monster taming chance; mindless, undead, demons, and unique/quest leaders cannot be tamed with food.

questions.questionText: Explain the mechanics of Elbereth in GnollHack. How does writing it with a wand of fire compare to writing it with a finger or athame in terms of durability and success?
questions.expectedPoints: Engraved Elbereth causes non-humanoid monsters to flee when stepping on or attacking; finger creates dust engraving (erodes easily), athame semi-permanent, wand of fire/lightning burns into floor (permanent until dug or magic eroded).

questions.questionText: In the GnollHack C core game logic, how is monster difficulty and level generation scaling computed in makemon.c?
questions.expectedPoints: Dungeon depth scaling, player experience level (u.ulevel) weighting, mon_difficulty function in monst.c/makemon.c, generation flags and out-of-depth spawn probabilities.

questions.questionText: Explain the multi-layer glyph rendering architecture in GnollHack: how are glyphs mapped to layer types (LAYER_FLOOR, LAYER_FEATURE, LAYER_OBJECT, LAYER_MONSTER) and rendered by SkiaSharp?
questions.expectedPoints: Glyph2Tile mapping array, LayerInfo multi-layer struct, separation into background, floor, feature, traps, objects, monsters, effects layers, SkiaSharp canvas drawing in GnollHackM frontend.

questions.questionText: In the GnollHack source code, what are the flags and attack tuples defined in monst.c for the Master Kaen monster?
questions.expectedPoints: MON macro definition in monst.c, high difficulty level, deadly martial arts/hand-to-hand claw/punch attack tuples, high MR, fast movement speed.

questions.questionText: Describe how the save/restore system in GnollHack preserves game state across platforms. What structs are serialized, and how are pointer adjustments handled during restore?
questions.expectedPoints: save.c and restore.c serialization, you (struct you) state, dlevel struct, mon/obj linked lists converted to ID references and reconstructed in restore.c.

questions.questionText: How does the native P/Invoke bridge connect the C core game loop to the .NET MAUI frontend via window_procs callbacks?
questions.expectedPoints: libshare native bridge in win/win32/xpl/libshare, struct window_procs function pointer table initialized at startup, P/Invoke delegate marshalling in GnollHackService.cs.
